name: Welcome
overview: Scripture reveals that welcoming others reflects our reception of Christ Himself, as shown in Matthew 25:40 where serving the least is equated with serving Jesus. Romans 15:7 calls believers to receive one another just as Christ received us, highlighting the glory of God in unity. Furthermore, Galatians 3:28 emphasizes that distinctions such as ethnicity, social status, or gender do not divide those united in Christ, underscoring the inclusive nature of Christian welcome.
